decisions.reason: The message separately defines the Big Block trigger and eligible population, and the existing same-message MODIFY already captures those changes completely.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the independent counters, Small Block eligibility window, and post-draw reset required by the source decision.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces affiliate-based eligibility with holders of tickets issued since the applicable block's previous draw.
The Small Block trigger and eligibility change does not alter the existing rule that secondary-sale royalties fund the prize pools.
The existing same-message Event already records the referral award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket; the Small Block draw change requires no further update.
The source explicitly says manual claim stays identical, so the prize-claim workflow remains valid unchanged.
The metadata requirement already exposes both ticket counters and permanent badges; changing Small Block draw eligibility and its trigger does not change those visibility requirements.
The source explicitly says the random ticket awarded when no referral code is used stays identical.

The Small Block mechanics change does not alter the requirement that secondary-sale royalties are required; the statement about royalties not creating tickets concerns ticket issuance rather than royalty enforcement.
